$comment: Cryptographic conformance vectors. Resolve the artifact (base example + optional RFC 7386 merge patch), build the signing input per Core Specification §6 (RFC 8785 canonical form with the signature member removed from the named container), and verify against the key_id's entry in test-keys.json. expect: verify = signature MUST validate; reject = verification MUST fail.

vectors.name: crypto-context-policy-eddsa-verifies
vectors.reason: The context policy is authenticated by the policy authority with Ed25519.

vectors.name: crypto-actor-registry-eddsa-verifies
vectors.reason: Actor identity, class, validity, and revocation state are signed by the registry authority.

vectors.name: crypto-catalog-eddsa-verifies
vectors.reason: The exact installed node catalog is signed by the catalog authority.

vectors.name: crypto-dispatch-attempt-eddsa-verifies
vectors.reason: The renderer dispatch attempt is signed by Coordination Runtime.

vectors.name: crypto-instance-es256-verifies
vectors.reason: The published ADAS instance carries a valid ES256 signature in JOSE raw (r||s) encoding.

vectors.name: crypto-context-eddsa-verifies
vectors.reason: The context snapshot is authenticated by the vehicle context authority with Ed25519.

vectors.name: crypto-capability-es256-verifies
vectors.reason: The renderer capability claim is attested by the renderer registry.

vectors.name: crypto-receipt-hmac-verifies
vectors.reason: The delivery receipt uses the symmetric session tier (HMAC-SHA-256).

vectors.name: crypto-response-hmac-verifies
vectors.reason: The explicit occupant response carries verified-input evidence.

vectors.name: crypto-tampered-policy-rejected
vectors.reason: A permissive post-signing policy mutation must invalidate policy authority.

vectors.name: crypto-tampered-actor-registry-rejected
vectors.reason: Any post-signing authority-registry mutation must invalidate the registry signature.

vectors.name: crypto-tampered-catalog-rejected
vectors.reason: A catalog version or declaration set cannot change without a new catalog signature.

vectors.name: crypto-tampered-dispatch-attempt-rejected
vectors.reason: A dispatch deadline cannot be extended after Coordination Runtime signs the attempt.

vectors.name: crypto-tampered-payload-rejected
vectors.reason: Any post-signing payload change must invalidate the signature.

vectors.name: crypto-tampered-nonce-rejected
vectors.reason: The nonce is inside the signing input; replay defence depends on it being immutable.

vectors.name: crypto-wrong-key-rejected
vectors.reason: A signature must verify only under the key named by key_id.

vectors.name: crypto-algorithm-confusion-rejected
vectors.reason: The declared algorithm is inside the signing input and must match the key's algorithm; cross-algorithm verification is forbidden.

vectors.name: crypto-transplanted-signature-rejected
vectors.reason: A signature transplanted onto different snapshot content must fail.
